subject: RECORD clause
notes: kb/Work PB737 (adjudication) claims a row that kb/Work PB339 implemented and pinned but deliberately left unclaimed because no note owned it. THE RULE HAS THREE OBLIGATIONS, NOT TWO, and all three are evidenced. (cite.py --check 13.18.43.4 'the number of bytes in the current record that participate as the sending operands in the implicit MOVE statement is determined by the following conditions' => OK 16); --check 13.18.43.4 'by the value that would have been moved into the data item referenced by data-name-1 had data-name-1 been specified' => OK 16); --check 13.18.43.4 'If the number of bytes determined as above is zero, the record is a zero-length item' => OK 16). ARM a) - data-name-1's content - is rendered by OperandText.CurrentRecordLength's DEPENDING branch, which forwards to the SAME renderer GR13 a) uses for RELEASE/REWRITE/WRITE (SequentialIoEmitter.VaryingLengthArg), so one rule text has one renderer. Pinned by pb339_into_current_record legs A/B/D/E (a sequential READ INTO from an FD with DEPENDING ON) and leg G (the RETURN twin through the SD's last-returned length). ARM b) - GR15's just-read length when no data-name-1 is written - is the connector-side FileLastReadLength / SortLastReturnedLength branch of the same method; pinned by leg F, a two-record FD with no DEPENDING phrase whose 5-byte WRITE reads back into a PIC X(10) JUSTIFIED receiver as '     ABCDE'. THE CLOSING SENTENCE - a zero byte count makes the record a zero-length item - is the third obligation and had no test until this adjudication. It is reachable, not a corner: 13.18.43.3 SR7 is 'Integer-2 shall be greater than or equal to zero' (--check 13.18.43.3 => OK 7)), so RECORD IS VARYING IN SIZE FROM 0 is legal source. OperandText.CurrentRecordImage passes allowZeroLength: true to the ref-mod slice for exactly this sentence, and MEASURED on this tree at 85/2002/2014/2023: a zero-length record read INTO a PIC X(5) pre-loaded with dots yields five SPACES (LEN=0000), neither the record area's leftover 'ZZZZZ' nor an EC-BOUND-REF-MOD, and the following READ still returns the next 4-byte record. New test conformance-test:SequentialFileIoSpecTests.VaryingRecord_ZeroLengthCurrentRecord_SendsNoBytesAndSpaceFills pins it as a [Theory] over all four editions. EDITION-INVARIANCE WAS DERIVED, NOT ASSUMED: no docs/VERSION_CHANGE_REFERENCE.md row touches 13.18.43, and the golden's bytes are identical at all four editions. FORMAT 3 (RECORD CONTAINS m TO n) is deliberately outside this rule - GR16 sits under the FORMAT 2 heading and GR18 puts a format-3 record's size in the record description entry instead. || EDITIONS AS ADJUDICATED: 1985 . 2002 . 2014 . 2023 || kb/Work PB348 (code-location only): the INTO sender builder moved from SequentialIoEmitter.IntoSender to MoveBinder.BindIntoPhrase when the implicit move of every INTO phrase became a BOUND sub-statement instead of an emitter-built node.
